nodes.label: Acceptance Criteria (AC-n)
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Observable, testable, unambiguous, business-worded, traceable; never invented beyond the ticket.

nodes.label: Six-Section Root-Cause Analysis
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Migrations lie; the live DB shows real state. No cause claimed without a quoted log, code branch or DB observation.

nodes.label: Seven-Section Code Explanation
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Explain from the implementation itself, never from filenames or symbol names.

nodes.label: Regression Classification (NEW / EXISTING / UNDETERMINED)
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Baseline is the repo's actual integration branch, never whatever is checked out locally.

nodes.label: find-bug Skill
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Prefer a few high-confidence, evidence-backed, reachable findings over speculative coverage.

nodes.label: qa-agent-advocate Skill (Hermes)
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Inline Hermes equivalent of the Claude Code qa-agent-advocate sub-agent; same SOP with tools translated.

nodes.label: test-design Skill
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Design the smallest evidence-backed set of sanity tests; analysis is fuel, not deliverable.

nodes.label: validate-bug Skill
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: A bug without black, grey and white box evidence is a suspicion, not a proof (courtroom analogy: witness, forensic test, DNA).

nodes.label: Black-Box Reproduction Rule
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Reproduction steps carry no internal functions, file paths or line numbers; those belong in Evidence.

nodes.author: Hermes Agent

nodes.rationale: Ticket given means files named by the verbatim Jira key; no ticket means chat output that still follows skill formats and advocate review.

nodes.rationale: Test cases come from the requirement, bug findings come from the code as it will ship; a branch name alone proves nothing.

nodes.label: Test Case Title Contract
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Titles readable by non-technical stakeholders; technical precision lives in preconditions, data and steps.

nodes.label: Unconditional find-bug Hand-off
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: An observation left in prose while the bug-candidate section reads 'None raised' is how a real finding disappears.

nodes.label: analyze-rootcause Skill
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: Evidence from logs, code, or live DB only; migrations lie, live schema tells the truth

nodes.label: find-bug Skill

nodes.rationale: Max 8 findings; every candidate challenged by qa-agent-advocate before reporting

nodes.rationale: Smallest evidence-backed set of feature + related regression tests

nodes.label: 3-Layer Evidence Framework (black/grey/white box)
nodes.author: Hermes Agent
nodes.rationale: A bug without all three layers is a suspicion, not a proof

nodes.label: qa-agent-advocate Agent
nodes.rationale: Adversarial reviewer that assumes every proposed bug may be wrong until hard evidence proves it; exactly one mode per task to avoid blending reviews.

nodes.label: /qa-agent Slash Command
nodes.rationale: qa-agent has no AskUserQuestion or Agent tool, so the command orchestrator relays its questions, re-invokes it, and spawns the advocate review.

nodes.label: Context-Prep Mode
nodes.rationale: Gather evidence in parallel while qa-agent is still working; render no verdict.

nodes.label: Known False-Positive Patterns
nodes.rationale: Lessons from prior review passes, e.g. migration claims from git history alone, staged lifecycle mistaken for inconsistent validation.

nodes.label: Proof Construction (mandatory 3-layer proof)
nodes.rationale: An argument, however sound, is not a substitute for an executed layer of evidence; caps verdicts when layers cannot run live.

nodes.label: Verdict Destination Rules
nodes.rationale: Rejected findings are removed from the bug file and recorded in the review file so a later pass cannot re-derive and re-file them.

nodes.label: Job 4: Offer Bug Hunt as Separate Step
nodes.norm_label: job 4: offer bug hunt as separate step
nodes.rationale: Keeps a plain test-case request from silently paying for a bug pass and two stacked advocate reviews.
